correctness.rationale: A simple induced graph has each component of size at most two iff every degree is at most one; a vertex with two neighbors generates a P₃ as a not-necessarily-induced subgraph even if the neighbors are adjacent. Independent exhaustive enumeration from the named Cayley and rook definitions confirmed the common strongly regular parameters, the distinct local neighborhoods, and agreement of component and degree predicates on all 65,536 masks of each graph. The nonempty face counts are 1,336 and 1,192. With the given pivot list and after releasing the empty-face–vertex-11 pair, the retained genuine covering pairs number 639 and 543. Topological sorting of all 4,960 and 4,224 oriented cover relations visits every face. This proves acyclicity; the one critical vertex and only 57 or 105 critical three-cells give CW models whose three-sphere wedge type follows because all attaching maps go to a point. No integral conclusion is inferred from the mod-two check. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/4e6a3499-bdf8-4d13-a677-8309fa9eb6c7/ind2_replay.py (saved ind2_replay_output.txt alongside).
